title: Analysis and funnel control for nonlinear drill strings
summary: We study the output tracking problem for a vertically driven drill string system described by a nonlinear boundary-coupled PDE-ODE model. Solvability analysis of the drill string model is achieved by first casting the model in an abstract boundary value problem involving set-valued operators on an appropriate Hilbert space. The governing equation here consists of evolution and the damping part.
